title: Chapter 1468 - 11: Legendary Lords From Different Times And Spaces (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1468 - 11: Legendary Lords From Different Times And Spaces (Part 2)

Chapter 1468 - 11: Legendary Lords from Different Times and Spaces (Part 2)

"Have you noticed, the deepest part of space-time is vibrating."

At this moment, Fantian Lord spoke, carefully observing the vibration of space-time, discovering that this vibration originated from the ancient past and the distant future.

At this moment.

Under the permeation of the Supreme Rule Dao's will, the past, present, and future were all affected.

Past space-time.

This was shortly after the endless dimensional planes were

established, with chaotic origin daos crossing each other, numerous powerful time beings, and terrifying time lords exploring paths of transcendence.

"Supreme Rule Dao's will..."

A colossus suddenly opened its eyes, its body equivalent to tens of thousands of top-dimensional spaces, even while asleep, its aura influenced vast dimensional gaps, causing time beings to merely comprehend its scattered aura and touch the Third Realm lord level.

"Actually directing me to a certain future space-time, to prevent the 'Galaxy' from climbing a new path of transcendence? If successful, it equates to passing ten trials? Wouldn't that mean directly completing the 'Infinite Origin' path?"

The colossus had an amused smile on its face, "Interesting, interesting, are there many new paths of transcendence in the future? Birth of paths paralleled to the 'Endless Tribulations"?"

For beings like the colossus, it could easily see that most paths of

transcendence ultimately failed to transcend, the most hopeful one being the 'Endless Tribulations, as this path of transcendence originated from the Supreme Rule Dao.

If one truly reached the end, the possibility of transcendence was still significant.

The colossus itself had already overcome three billion two hundred ninety million trials in the final stage, only ten trials away from completely finishing.

However, as it approached the end, the colossus became more

cautious, not daring to take trials lightly, yet now the Supreme Rule Dao's will actively descended tribulations, and even if it failed, it wouldn't erase.

The colossus naturally had interest.

"Very well."

"Let's take a look."

The colossus decided in its heart, first to see if it could successfully pass this trial, and secondly to observe what kind of lifeform the 'Galaxy' was, which incited such actions from the Supreme Rule Dao's will.

Buzz- Just before the colossus decided to take the trial, the Supreme Rule Dao's will power spread, guiding the colossus to a certain future space-time.

Without guidance from the Supreme Rule Dao's will, the colossus would almost never be able to find this space-time, as the future contained countless divergent branches, becoming increasingly intricate.

However, before leaving, the colossus prepared some arrangements.

After all, upon traveling to future space-time, it was unpredictable how long it would take to return.

The colossus neither affirmed nor denied.

But also said nothing more.

"Alright, then you explore first, we'll discuss when I return."

The colossus nodded, finally glancing at the many disciples, then stepped into the future space-time guided by the Supreme Rule Dao's

will. After the colossus left, the disciples subsequently disappeared.

Finally, only 'Wu You' is left.

"Teacher, rest assured, I can definitely prove that the 'Perfect Time

Being' is indeed a true path to transcendence."

Wu You silently pondered in his heart.

...

Another ancient space-time.

An existence filled with infinite light, influencing the dimensional

spaces, opened its eyes, "Journey to the future time-space to stop 'Galaxy' from ascending the new transcendence path?"

"What kind of transcendence path actually triggers the Supreme Rule Will to descend calamity by itself?"

The infinitely luminous being thought with interest: "Even when the unbeatable 'Wu You' Lord attempted to reach the Perfect Time Being level, at the cost of his life, and evolved half a thread of transcendence power to prove the existence of the transcendence path of 'Perfect Time Being, it only caused the Supreme Rule Dao Will

to tremble without specially descending calamity...

"Let's take a look."

After pondering for a while, the being filled with infinite light similarly

followed the Supreme Rule Dao Will's guidance to proceed to that

future time-space.

"Journey to the future time-space to stop 'Galaxy' from ascending the

new transcendence path?"

Just finished a retreat, the Returning Ruins Lord's expression slightly shifted: "Success is equivalent to overcoming a thousand calamities, and failure will not result in eradication?"

"I have now surpassed three billion and one thousand calamities, another thousand calamities, wouldn't it achieve three billion and two thousand calamities?" The Returning Ruins Lord considered for a

while. He is clearly aware that the Supreme Rule Dao Will will not be so 'generous', preventing the Galaxy Lord from ascending the new transcendence path definitely won't be easy.

However, even in failure, there is no punishment; it will not be obliterated by the Supreme Rule Dao Will.

Naturally, the Returning Ruins Lord doesn't mind giving it a try.

"Let's go."

The Returning Ruins Lord immediately followed the Supreme Rule Dao Will's guidance to proceed to a certain future time-space.

Distant future time-space.

Every Legendary Lord who has overcome more than three billion

calamities has also received the calamity descended by the Supreme Rule Dao Will.

"Journey to a certain past time-space to stop Galaxy's ascendancy on the new transcendence path?"

"This Galaxy, why does it sound so familiar?"

"I remember, it's that existence?"

"Not going, only a fool would go."

Compared to past time-space, every Legendary Lord of three billion

calamities in future time-space evidently knows or has heard something, regardless of how great the 'benefits' given by the Supreme Rule Dao Will, they remain unmoved.

Of course, accompanying the increasingly distant future time-space, gradually there are some Legendary Lords who have never understood that some choose to accept the calamity descended by

the Supreme Rule Dao Will.

Current time-space.

Lord Haotian, Fantian Lord, and other eight Legendary Lords of three

billion calamities are observing the time vibration vaguely connecting past and future.

In the next moment.

Under their shocking gaze, figures exuding terrifying auras that seem to encompass endless dimensions continually appear. These figures merely standing there begin to naturally influence the

surrounding time-space, as if all things in the universe revere them.

"This...this..."

Lord Haotian, Fantian Lord, and other Legendary Lords were dumbfounded, the figures stepping out of the deepest time vibration, even the weakest of them are not inferior to them. Over ninety percent of the figures emanate auras that transcend

them, especially some figures among them, even a slight glance causes Lord Haotian, Fantian Lord, and other Legendary Lords to feel

a bit amazed, as if they saw the endpoint of a transcendence path.

"They are... Compared to Lord Haotian and Fantian Lord, the Sage's heart has the greatest tremor.

He has experienced incomparably long epochs, and the 'Lord Wu You' pioneering the Perfect Time Being transcendence path, the figures

stepping out of the deepest time vibration, many are claimed as invincible, overlooked endless dimensional dimensions.

Soon.

The deepest time vibration gradually subsided.

At this moment, from past to future, across different time-spaces, a

total of five hundred and three figures quietly stood in the void, their intangible aura colliding and interweaving, chaotic a series of timelines.

These five hundred and three figures, even the weakest among them are Legendary Lords who have overcome three billion calamities. Most are three billion one thousand calamities, three billion two thousand calamities.

There are also those with more than three billion two hundred ninety-nine hundred calamities, only dozens or a few calamities away from traversing the 'Infinite Calamities' transcendence path.
